Happy Hour · Hilton Head Island

The Best Happy Hour on Hilton Head Island

Seven days a week, 4 to 6 PM, at Shelter Cove: $5.50 draft margaritas, $5 wells and wine, and bar snacks priced to share after a day on the island.

By Tio's Latin American Kitchen · November 22, 2026 · 4 min read

Quick answer

Tio's Latin American Kitchen at Shelter Cove Towne Centre (40 Shelter Cove Ln #181, Hilton Head Island, SC) has happy hour every day from 4 to 6 PM. House margaritas are $5.50, wells and house wine are $5, beer is $1 off, and bar snacks start at $1 for fresh salsa, with tacos from $4.50.

Happy hour on Hilton Head, every single day

Some happy hours skip the weekend. Ours does not. Tio's pours happy hour seven days a week from 4 to 6 PM, which makes it an easy first stop after the beach, the bike path or a day on the water. We are at Shelter Cove Towne Centre, with a patio out front and plenty of parking.

Happy hour drinks

  • House Margarita ($5.50): poured on draft at a cool 32 degrees.
  • Wells ($5): vodka, rum, gin, whiskey or tequila.
  • House Wine ($5): Chardonnay or Cabernet Sauvignon.
  • Island Time ($6): Blue Chair Bay Coconut Rum, pineapple juice, orange juice and lemon-lime soda.
  • Texas Mule ($7): Tito's Handmade Vodka, ginger beer and lime.
  • Beer: $1 off domestic bottles, import bottles and draft pints.

The star is the house margarita: limes hand squeezed daily and poured on draft so it lands ice cold. Read more in our guide to the best margaritas on Hilton Head Island.

Happy hour food: botanas and tacos

  • Fresh Salsa ($1) and Queso ($4), both with warm tortilla chips made fresh daily.
  • Zuniga's Empanada ($4): ground beef or chicken with Tio's slaw, sofrito salsa and chipotle cream.
  • Happy hour tacos from $4.50: Cuban roasted pork, shredded chicken or ground beef. Al pastor is $5 and USA shrimp is $5.50.
  • Loaded Yuca or Plantains ($6), with a vegan style loaded yuca too.
  • Ceviche, Chicken Flautas or Mussels ($6 each).
  • Pinchos ($7): a skewer of adobo marinated steak on Tio's slaw.

See everything, including shots and guacamole at market price, on the full happy hour menu.

How to do island happy hour right

Come straight from the beach around 4, start with $1 salsa and a margarita, then build a table of tacos and botanas to share. Staying for dinner? Sizzling fajitas and our full menu are ready when happy hour ends. For the taco rundown, see the best tacos on Hilton Head Island.

From the Tio's bar

Our bartenders like to have fun. Here is the Big Azz Bloody Mary from our Sunday brunch menu, topped like a meal.

More reasons to come by during the week

Tuesday is Trivia and Taco Tuesday, Wednesday is Girls Night Out with Music Bingo from 4 to 9 PM (Bluffton's is on Thursdays, see Girls Night Out in Bluffton), and Thursday is All You Can Eat Tacos and Nachos for $19.99. The whole week is on the events page.

Find Tio's on Hilton Head Island

40 Shelter Cove Ln #181, Shelter Cove Towne Centre. Open daily 11 AM to 9:30 PM. Call (843) 842-8467 or see the Hilton Head location page. On the mainland? Here is the best happy hour in Bluffton.

Must be 21 to consume alcohol. Please drink responsibly. Menu items and prices are subject to change and may vary by location.

Frequently asked questions

What time is happy hour at Tio's on Hilton Head Island?

Happy hour is every day from 4 to 6 PM at Tio's in Shelter Cove Towne Centre, including Saturdays and Sundays.

How much are margaritas during happy hour on Hilton Head?

House margaritas are $5.50 during happy hour at Tio's Hilton Head.

Is there happy hour food at Tio's Hilton Head?

Yes. Bar snacks include $1 fresh salsa, $4 queso, $4 empanadas and tacos from $4.50, plus ceviche, flautas and mussels for $6 each.

Where is Tio's on Hilton Head Island?

Tio's is at 40 Shelter Cove Ln #181 in Shelter Cove Towne Centre, open daily from 11 AM to 9:30 PM.
